senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. עוּץ, [to press,] to encourage, plan; to advise.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 61a:29">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>כליות יוֹעֲצוֹת</he> the kidneys are the seat of deliberation.
<cite ref="Berakhot 61a:28">Ib.</cite> <he>אחת יוֹעַצְתּוֹ לטובה וכ׳</he> one (kidney) urges him to do good etc.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 8b:13">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>וכשיוֹעֲצִים אין יועצים וכ׳</he> and when they (the Medians) hold council, they meet in open air.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 87a:11">Snh. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>ממך זה יוֹעֵץ</he> ‘hidden from thee’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 17:8">Deut. XVII, 8</cite>) that means (the need of) a counselor (<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 152:2">Sifré Deut. 152</cite> <he>זו עצה</he>).

<cite ref="Chullin 11a:11">Ḥull. 11ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>לעמת הֶעָצֶה</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 3:9">Lev. III, 9</cite>) <he>ממקים שהכליות יועצות</he> from where the deliberating kidneys are seated, v. supra.—
<cite ref="Temurah 16a:59">Tem. 16ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>י̇ע̇ב̇ץ̇</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:9">I Chr. IV, 9</cite>) <he>שי̇ע̇ץ וריב̇ץ̇ וכ׳</he> he advised and advanced the study of the Law &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>בלעם שי׳</he> Balaam who gave his advice (encouraging the oppression of the Israelites); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Berakhot 3b:32">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 16a">Snh. 16ᵃ</cite>, v. infra.]

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְיָעֵץ to ask advice; to consult with (with ב).
units: Yalk. Ps. 776 מִתְיָעֲצִים באחיתופל (Ber. 3ᵇ; Snh. 16ᵃ יועצין, read: נוֹעָצִין, Nif.) they deliberated with Ah.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 53b:17">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (in enigmatic speech) <he>נתי׳ במכתיר</he> took counsel of the Nasi (v. <cite ref="K01386"><he>כָּתַר</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 157:1">Sifré Num. 157</cite> <he>שהיו מתייעצים על וכ׳</he> they were planning against Israel; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 785:28">Yalk. Num. 785</cite> <he>מִיָּעֲצִים</he>.
